sloka: उदिते विमले सूर्ये पुष्ये च अभ्यागते अहनि ।अभिषेकाय रामस्य द्विज इन्द्रैः उपकल्पितम् ॥२-१५-३॥
transliteration: udite vimale sūrye puṣye ca abhyāgate ahani ।abhiṣekāya rāmasya dvija indraiḥ upakalpitam ॥2-15-3॥

translations.english: The best of brahmins had decided to perform the consecration ceremony after the bright Sun appeared in the sky when the Pushya star approached the karkataka lagna, which was the constellation at the time of Rama's birth.
